title: Did not work for us
text: Did not work for us. I had to send it back, didn't give enough heat at all. I was hoping to get more out of it, so not sure if we got a defect one or if it's generally that way. You could touch the heater right in front without feeling much warmth, so we went ahead and bought a different one.
